Thanks, team. Quick procurement checklist and proposed flow: 

1) PO creation: procurement generates an internal PO number after commercial terms are finalized. We will create PO INF-2026-9873 for this engagement. Once created, we can either (a) send a DocuSign packet with the PO attached for your signature, or (b) provide a PDF PO and collect an e-signed DPA separately. Which do you prefer?

2) DPA: please share a one-line changelog for the v3 DPA (what clauses were updated). Our legal intake prefers to see the change-summary and the final doc in DocuSign if possible. We will accept your DPA with limited redlines; major scope changes may need negotiation.

3) SOC 2: Marta, thanks for the link. Procurement requests the SOC 2 period (e.g., 2025-06 to 2026-06) and confirmation that the report includes a signed auditor letter. If so, you can either: (i) upload the PDF to our secure S3 intake (I’ll share a link in a follow-up), or (ii) deliver as an attachment to the DocuSign packet.

4) Subprocessors: we need the CSV you attached to enumerate any EU/UK data subprocessors separately; please tag rows that host customer data.

Action items/next steps:
- Orbit: confirm preferred PO signature flow (DocuSign vs. separate) and invoice cadence (monthly/quarterly) — due Tue 2026-09-28.
- Orbit: provide SOC 2 report period and signed auditor letter (or upload PDF) — due Tue 2026-09-28.
- Orbit: supply a short changelog for DPA v3 — due Tue 2026-09-28.
- Redwood: I will provision PO INF-2026-9873 once commercial terms are final.

Ben — if you want to take the commercial lead on the DocuSign packet, take it from here.

— Jonas
